title: kb_topics_for reads any server path on a server limited by --roots
goal: On a server limited by --roots (every kb_http.py), kb_topics_for refuses its paths argument with a tool error and still answers text, so no request reads, lists or confirms files outside the served roots; unlimited local servers keep paths; test_kb_http_topics_for_paths_refused calls it over HTTP with a path outside the served roots and proves the refusal
